$schema-note: Canonical Möbi𝒰s product design tokens. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. The macOS app (ui/macos/CDCStudio/Sources/CDCStudio/DesignSystem/MobiusTokens.swift) and the web console (ui/web/console/index.html) mirror these values verbatim; scripts/verify.sh fails if any surface drifts. Every value is derived from the shipped identity system (docs/identity/MOBIUS_U_IDENTITY_SYSTEM.md, assets/identity/*.svg) — nothing here is invented decoration.

ember.note: The ONLY warm token in the system. Reserved exclusively for a violated invariant (-1). Never used for emphasis, branding, or ordinary alerts.

ternary.note: The product's result carrier is balanced ternary, not boolean. Zero is resting equilibrium — a first-class outcome, never styled as a lesser failure (Amendment A7, relational zero).

geometry.tiltNote: 7.16197° is the wordmark's shipped identity invariant (verified in the identity asset gate). It is the ONLY rotational accent angle in the product.

type.monoNote: Coordinates, trits, and digests are always monospaced — they are addresses, not prose.

motion.note: Motion performs the second turn: one turn inverts the sheet, two turns restore it. Every signature animation is a 720° restoration, never a spinner.
